title: Add date selection and totalizer tracking for sales and shifts

requirements.text: Add a date picker field to the new sale form to allow entering or selecting a custom date for backdated sales entries

quotes: In the new sale option, there should be an option to enter or select a date for making old entries

acceptanceCriteria: Date picker component is added to the SalesForm component
Selected date is captured and stored with each sale record
Date defaults to current date/time if not explicitly changed
Backend Sale type includes optional timestamp field for custom dates

requirements.text: Add open totalizer and end totalizer numeric input fields to the new sale form

quotes: there should also be an option for open totalizer and end totalizer

acceptanceCriteria: Two numeric input fields added to SalesForm: 'Open Totalizer' and 'End Totalizer'
Fields accept decimal values representing totalizer readings
Both fields are clearly labeled in the form

requirements.text: Automatically calculate and display the volume of petrol or diesel dispensed based on the difference between end totalizer and open totalizer readings

quotes: It should calculate and tell you how many liters of petrol and diesel are there

acceptanceCriteria: Calculated volume is displayed in real-time as (End Totalizer - Open Totalizer)
Calculation updates automatically when either totalizer value changes
Volume is displayed with appropriate units (liters)
Validation ensures end totalizer is greater than or equal to open totalizer

requirements.text: Store open totalizer and end totalizer readings with each sale record in the backend

quotes: there should also be an option for open totalizer and end totalizer

acceptanceCriteria: Sale record type in backend includes optional openTotalizer and endTotalizer fields
Totalizer values are persisted when creating new sales
Totalizer data is retrievable when querying sales records

requirements.text: Add start shift date and time picker fields to the Start New Shift dialog

quotes: The Start New Shift option should include the Start Shift Date and Time to help with old entries

acceptanceCriteria: Date and time picker component is added to the shift start dialog in ShiftManagement component
Selected date/time is captured when starting a new shift
Date/time defaults to current date/time if not explicitly changed
Backend Shift type supports custom start timestamp for backdated shifts

constraints: Maintain existing offline support functionality for sales entries
Preserve current shift management and staff assignment logic
Ensure totalizer calculations work for both petrol and diesel fuel types
nonGoals: Modifying existing sale records or shift records
Adding totalizer tracking to other components beyond new sales
Implementing automatic totalizer synchronization with physical pump hardware
Adding date selection to expense entries or other modules
